text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting.
- 1996 revenues amount to more than 42 per cent of budget.
- Saddam calls for more austerity measures.
- Iraq and India review industrial cooperation.
- Iraqi engineers repair more than 33 production machines.
- Saddam gives orders to develop housing complexes and plantations along the Shatt al-Arab waterway.
(The above were also carried by AL-THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Article recounts latest positive indicators in Iraqi economy.
- Commentary addressing questions about why the United States and its allies have a hostile attitude towards Iraq and its leader Saddam Hussein.
- Commentary says peace between Arabs and Israel is far away.
- Editorial attacks U.S. attempts to control the world by the use of multimedia systems particularly the Internet.
- Commentary lashes out at United States for delays in arrival of food supplies.
